Dunn & Acosta LLP
Conroe, TX
Phone 713-555-4341
Settlement Demand
26 Oct 2023
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1254 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our firm represents Marcus Davidson in connection with the collision that occurred in
a parking lot on 7 Feb 2023. Our client was stopped and waiting for a parking space
when your insured's vehicle backed into the driver's side of our client's car. The
impact was forceful enough to deflect our client's vehicle and trigger airbag
deployment in the adjacent seat area. Liability is clear: your insured failed to
yield, failed to keep a proper lookout while reversing, and caused the collision
entirely.
Following the accident, our client was transported for evaluation and diagnosed with
cervical and lumbar strain. Our client has undergone physical therapy and continues to
experience neck stiffness, lower back pain, and headaches that interfere with work and
daily activities. Our client's treating physician has recommended ongoing care, and
records documenting treatment and associated costs are available upon request.
Our client's damages include medical expenses, lost wages, pain and suffering, and the
diminished enjoyment of ordinary life. Considering these losses, our client will
accept $44,000.00 in full settlement of all claims arising from this collision. This
offer remains open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a
satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice.
Expert review: Matthew Moore, biomechanical engineer
Sincerely,
Laura Bryant
Dunn & Acosta LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
